tools.name: about
tools.description: What Tester Exchange is, how credits work, and every available action.

tools.name: platform_stats
tools.description: Live platform numbers: members, apps testing, open tester slots, verified tester-days.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: How credits are earned and spent, and credit pack prices.

tools.name: list_open_tests
tools.description: Android apps currently looking for closed-testing testers. With a token, only tests the user can join.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: The user's credit balance, invite link, phones linked and open tests. (needs a token)

tools.name: my_apps
tools.description: The user's apps and the live status of each testing campaign (active testers, waiting installs, open slots). (needs a token)

tools.name: add_app
tools.description: List an Android app that is in Google Play closed testing. The closed track must be published with the opt-in link enabled. (needs a token)

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.description: Start recruiting testers for one of the user's apps. Costs testers × 15 credits, held in escrow; unused credits are refunded. (needs a token)

tools.name: campaign_report
tools.description: Testers, daily active testers, feedback and the data needed to answer Play Console's production-access questions. (needs a token)

tools.name: add_testers
tools.description: Add tester slots to a live campaign (15 credits each). (needs a token)

tools.name: set_campaign_status
tools.description: Pause, resume or close a campaign. Closing refunds unused credits. (needs a token)

tools.name: join_test
tools.description: Join another developer's test as a tester. Returns the opt-in steps the human must do on their phone. (needs a token)

tools.name: my_tests
tools.description: Tests the user is doing as a tester, with verified days and credits earned. (needs a token)

tools.name: share_kit
tools.description: Public "help test my app" page, a ready message and a README badge for one of the user's apps. (needs a token)

tools.name: buy_credits_links
tools.description: Checkout links for credit packs. A human must complete the payment. (needs a token)

tools.name: swap_circle_status
tools.description: How full the next free swap circle is. It starts at 6 developers (or on Monday with at least 3); then everyone tests everyone else's app for 14 days, free.

tools.name: join_swap_circle
tools.description: Put one of the user's apps in the free swap circle. Needs the Tester Exchange app on the user's phone (a linked phone). (needs a token)

tools.name: my_swap_circle
tools.description: The user's swap circle: status, how many developers are in, and the apps. (needs a token)

tools.name: leave_swap_circle
tools.description: Leave the swap circle while it is still filling. (needs a token)

tools.name: friends_status
tools.description: Who fills the 12 seats of one of the user's apps (friends, swap circle, exchange testers), how many seats are left, what the exchange would cost for them, and the share link. (needs a token)

tools.name: start_friends_test
tools.description: Free: open a test for one of the user's apps so friends and family can join from the share link. Returns the link and a ready message. Their days are verified by the Tester Exchange phone app. (needs a token)

tools.name: fill_from_exchange
tools.description: Pay credits only for the seats friends and the circle don't fill (15 credits per seat); exchange testers then join. (needs a token)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_friends_test · Private data: list_open_tests, my_account, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign_report, add_testers, set_campaign_status, join_test, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits_links, join_swap_circle, my_swap_circle, leave_swap_circle, friends_status, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange · Public sink: share_kit, friends_status, start_friends_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_friends_test · Private data: list_open_tests, my_account, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign, campaign_report, add_testers, set_campaign_status, join_test, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits_links, join_swap_circle, my_swap_circle, leave_swap_circle, friends_status, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange · Public sink: share_kit, friends_status, start_friends_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
